description: ESS, DVCC, generator start/stop and Dynamic ESS settings of a Victron GX device
source: Victron Energy, CCGX Modbus TCP register list 3.81
notes: Registers of the com.victronenergy.settings service of the GX Modbus TCP server (Settings > Integrations > Modbus TCP server).
The unit ID of this service is 100.
All registers are holding registers (FC03; FC06/FC16 for the writable ones).

registers.name: ESS max charge current (fractional)
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/MaxChargePercentage; ESS Mode 2 - Max charge current for ESS control-loop. The control-loop will use this value to limit the multi power setpoint. For DVCC, use 2705 instead

registers.name: ESS control loop setpoint (2703)
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/AcPowerSetPoint; ESS Mode 2 – Same as 2700, but with a different scale factor. Meant for values larger than +-32kW

registers.name: ESS max discharge current
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/MaxDischargePower; ESS Mode 2 – similar to 2702, but as an absolute value instead of a percentage

registers.name: DVCC system max charge current
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/SystemSetup/MaxChargeCurrent; ESS Mode 2 with DVCC – Maximum system charge current. -1 Disables

registers.name: Maximum System Grid Feed In
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/MaxFeedInPower; -1: No limit, >=0: limited system feed-in. Applies to DC-coupled and AC-coupled feed-in

registers.name: Feed excess DC-coupled PV into grid

enum.0: Don’t feed excess DC-tied PV into grid
enum.1: Feed excess DC-tied PV into the grid

registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/OvervoltageFeedIn; Also known as Overvoltage Feed-in

registers.name: Don’t feed excess AC-coupled PV into grid

enum.0: Feed excess AC-tied PV into grid
enum.1: Don’t feed excess AC-tied PV into the grid

registers.name: Limit managed battery voltage
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/SystemSetup/MaxChargeVoltage; Only used if there is a managed battery in the system

registers.name: AC input 1 source (for VE.Bus inverter/chargers)
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/SystemSetup/AcInput1; For Multi-RS, this is configured on the Inverter/Charger with VictronConnect

registers.name: ESS max discharge current (2720)
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/MaxDischargePower; This is a 32-bit version of 2704

registers.name: Maximum System Grid Feed In (2722)
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/Cgwacs/MaxFeedInPower; This is a 32-bit version of 2706

registers.name: ESS BatteryLife state
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/CGwacs/BatteryLife/State; Use value 0 (disable) and 1(enable) for writing only

registers.name: ESS Minimum SoC (unless grid fails)
registers.description: D-Bus /Settings/CGwacs/BatteryLife/MinimumSocLimit; Same as the setting in the GUI

registers.name: Allow grid feed-in during this schedule

enum.0: No restrictions between battery and the grid
enum.1: Battery to grid energy flow is restricted
enum.2: Grid to battery energy flow is restricted
enum.3: No energy flow between battery and grid

registers.name: Unix timestamp when this schedule starts
